The '''Submarine Transport''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] compact [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] developed by [[Urukabb|Urukaab]]. The transport used [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology to travel quickly and quietly through the water. The design was modified by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] to transport [[Sea Commando]] teams through [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled waters.
